q: What is the primary purpose of the Windows taskbar?
options: Providing quick access to open programs and the Start menu
explain: टास्कबार से Start मेन्यू, खुले प्रोग्राम और पिन किए ऐप तुरंत खुलते हैं।

q: Complete the following sentence with an adverb. Babita has done ____ beautiful embroidery on the sheet.
explain: 'Too much' (क्रियाविशेषण) मात्रा बताता है; Similar/Good विशेषण हैं, He सर्वनाम।

q: Which statement best describes the relationship between the work done in raising an object and its gain in potential energy?
options: The work done is less than the gain in potential energy
The object loses energy equal to the work done
The work done is equal to the gain in potential energy
The work done is greater than the gain in potential energy
explain: वस्तु को ऊपर उठाने में किया गया कार्य = स्थितिज ऊर्जा में वृद्धि (mgh)।

q: Select the correct sentence that transforms the given sentence to Direct Speech: He said that he was going to the market.
options: He said, "I was going to the market."
He said, "I am going to the market."
He said, "I will go to the market."
He said, "I went to the market."
explain: Indirect का past continuous (was going) Direct में present continuous (am going) बनता है।

q: Rearrange the jumbled sections to form a meaningful sentence. A: was completed  B: before the deadline  C: the group project  D: with everyone's effort  E: successfully
explain: The group project (C) was completed (A) successfully (E) before the deadline (B) with everyone's effort (D)।

q: F, G, H, I, J and K live on six different floors (lowest = 1, top = 6). I lives on an even floor just above H. Only three people live between I and K. G lives on an even floor just above J. On which floor does J live?
Choose the correct one-word substitute for the highlighted phrase: The author received great recognition after his death, when his final novel was published worldwide.
explain: मृत्यु के बाद मिलने वाली मान्यता — posthumously (मरणोपरांत)।

q: During computer development, what feature is most relevant to third-generation machines in terms of building and user interfaces?
options: Introduction of integrated circuits and use of operating systems for better interaction
Use of vacuum tubes for direct communication and programming from binary
Use of microprocessors in personal computers
Use of artificial intelligence and natural language
explain: तीसरी पीढ़ी (1964–71) — इंटीग्रेटेड सर्किट (IC) और ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम; वैक्यूम ट्यूब पहली पीढ़ी।

q: What is the main benefit of using antivirus software as part of an information protection strategy?
explain: एंटीवायरस का मुख्य कार्य मैलवेयर पहचानना और हटाना है।

q: The iron and steel industry is called a basic industry because it ________.
options: Is fully owned by private firms
Supplies raw materials to many other industries
Is located only in coastal areas
explain: लोहा-इस्पात अन्य उद्योगों को कच्चा माल देता है, इसलिए आधारभूत उद्योग।

q: In August 1765, after the Battle of Buxar, Mughal Emperor Shah Alam II granted the English East India Company which official title to collect revenues from Bengal, Bihar and Orissa?
explain: इलाहाबाद की संधि (1765) से कंपनी को बंगाल, बिहार, उड़ीसा की दीवानी (राजस्व अधिकार) मिली।

q: Why can a user choose 'Save As' after opening an existing MS Word document?
options: To close the document without saving changes
To create a new file with a different name or location
To open any file in read-only mode
explain: Save As से फ़ाइल नई जगह/नए नाम से सेव होती है।

q: Which scenario best illustrates the use of computers in decision-making in the healthcare sector?
options: A clinic uses a computer to book patient appointments and send reminders
A hospital analyzes patient data to estimate disease outbreaks
A student types a health assignment
explain: डेटा विश्लेषण से बीमारी फैलने का अनुमान — निर्णय लेने में कंप्यूटर का उपयोग।

q: The National Chambal Sanctuary (National Chambal Gharial Wildlife Sanctuary) was first declared a protected area in 1978 in which state?
explain: राष्ट्रीय चंबल अभयारण्य 1978 में मध्य प्रदेश में घोषित; बाद में राजस्थान व UP में भी।

q: What action of Gandhi in 1930 turned the opposition to the salt tax into a major national campaign?
options: Refusal to participate in round table conferences
Establishment of the All India Trade Union Congress
explain: 12 मार्च 1930 — साबरमती से दांडी तक नमक यात्रा, सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन की शुरुआत।

q: Choose the sentence that correctly expresses an interrogative form in the active voice.
options: Is the article being written by you?
Was the letter written by her?
explain: बाकी तीनों passive हैं; 'Did you see the film?' active interrogative है।

q: Fill in the blanks: The scientist proposed ___ hypothesis supported by ___ empirical observation collected over several years of fieldwork.
explain: hypothesis व्यंजन ध्वनि → a; empirical स्वर ध्वनि → an।

q: A, B and C start a business investing in the ratio 2:3:5. If C's share in the profit is ₹1,500, what is the total profit?
Numbers: 183 647 925 762 514. If the product of the first and third digits of the largest number is added to the second digit of the smallest number, what is the result?
Which function is mainly controlled by the cerebellum in the human brain?
explain: अनुमस्तिष्क (cerebellum) शरीर का संतुलन और मुद्रा बनाए रखता है।

q: Choose the option which best replaces the underlined phrase: The committee rejected the proposal because it was too vague and open to multiple interpretations.
explain: कई अर्थ निकलने वाला — ambiguous (अस्पष्ट/द्विअर्थी)।

q: A short agricultural season between Rabi and Kharif in which watermelon, muskmelon and cucumber are grown is called:
explain: रबी और खरीफ के बीच का छोटा मौसम — जायद।

q: On 5 September 2026, ISRO successfully conducted a hot test of the Power Head Test Article (PHTA) at full thrust for which type of engine?
explain: PHTA ISRO के सेमी-क्रायोजेनिक इंजन (SE2000, LOX-केरोसिन) का परीक्षण मॉड्यूल है।

q: What is the formula unit mass of sodium chloride (NaCl)?
Identify the segment with an error: She go / to school / every morning / with her friends.
explain: She के साथ 'goes' आएगा — त्रुटि 'She go' में।

q: In the Braj region of Uttar Pradesh, Lathmar Holi is celebrated between which two towns?
explain: लट्ठमार होली बरसाना और नंदगाँव के बीच खेली जाती है।

q: Mr. Bucky drives 11 km south, turns right and drives 7 km, turns right and drives 21 km, turns right and drives 23 km, turns right and drives 10 km to reach P. How far and in which direction should he drive to return to A?
Choose the correct idiom: The new student proved to be someone with hidden talents that nobody expected.
explain: Dark horse — छिपी प्रतिभा वाला जो अप्रत्याशित रूप से सफल हो।

q: You accidentally typed "Teh" instead of "The" several times. Which feature can fix this throughout the worksheet?
explain: आधिकारिक कुंजी: Find and Replace — एक बार में पूरी शीट में सभी 'Teh' बदल जाते हैं।

q: लोकोक्ति का अर्थ: 'नई दुकान में मालिक को खुद खड़ा होना पड़ता है, क्योंकि बिना मरे स्वर्ग नहीं मिलता।'
options: बड़ा बनने के लिए स्वार्थी बनो
काम स्वयं किए बिना ठीक नहीं होता
स्वर्ग मरने के बाद ही मिलता है
नई दुकान में काम न करें
explain: 'आप मरे बिना स्वर्ग नहीं दिखता' — अपना काम स्वयं करने पर ही ठीक होता है।

q: What is the full form of CPU, called the brain of the computer?
explain: CPU = Central Processing Unit।

q: People travelling in a vehicle, ship or aircraft are collectively known as:
explain: वाहन/जहाज़/विमान में यात्रा करने वाले — passengers।

q: Fill in the blank: My wallet ______ in a crowded bus.
explain: Passive voice, past: was + V3 → was stolen।

q: Select the SYNONYM of 'profound': The policy had a profound impact on society.
explain: Profound = deep (गहरा)।

q: He is interested ___ learning French.
explain: interested के साथ preposition 'in'।

q: Which Union Ministry compiles and releases the headline All-India CPI with base revisions from the Household Consumption Expenditure Survey?
options: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
explain: All-India CPI (ग्रामीण/शहरी/संयुक्त) MoSPI का NSO जारी करता है।

q: The brain and spinal cord together form ______ nervous system.
explain: मस्तिष्क + मेरुरज्जु = केंद्रीय तंत्रिका तंत्र (CNS)।

q: The Grand Banks off Newfoundland are rich fishing areas formed by the convergence of the warm Gulf Stream and which cold current?
explain: गल्फ स्ट्रीम (गर्म) + लैब्राडोर (ठंडी) धारा के मिलन से ग्रैंड बैंक्स।

q: To move a sentence from start to finish in MS Word without retyping, which sequence is best?
explain: Cut (Ctrl+X) → Paste (Ctrl+V) से टेक्स्ट स्थानांतरित होता है।

q: Which statement regarding atomic number is incorrect?
options: Atomic number represents the number of protons in the nucleus
The atomic number is equal to the sum of protons and neutrons
Atomic number is denoted by Z
Modern periodic table is based on atomic number
explain: प्रोटॉन + न्यूट्रॉन = द्रव्यमान संख्या, परमाणु क्रमांक नहीं।

q: Remote teams need real-time collaboration, instant file sharing and integration with project tools. Which best meets these needs?
options: Cloud-based collaborative platforms like Slack or Microsoft Teams
explain: Slack/Teams जैसे क्लाउड प्लेटफॉर्म रियल-टाइम सहयोग देते हैं।

q: A sound wave oscillates 50 times in 1 second. What is its time period?
According to Census 2011, which state recorded the highest sex ratio (1,084 females per 1,000 males)?
explain: जनगणना 2011 में केरल का लिंगानुपात 1084 — सर्वाधिक।

q: A researcher wants to study a major devotional composition in Awadhi describing the life of Ram. Which work is most suitable?
explain: तुलसीदास का रामचरितमानस अवधी में राम-कथा है; पद्मावत (जायसी) प्रेमकथा, सूरसागर ब्रज में।

q: 15,625 registered voters; 80% voted; 5% of votes invalid; winner got 52% of valid votes. Votes received by winner?
A security engineer uses encryption tools at multiple stages of data transmission. What does this indicate?
options: Encryption tools are used after data reaches its destination
Encryption tools are only required before transmission
Encryption is used at multiple stages to protect data throughout transmission
explain: हर चरण पर एन्क्रिप्शन — पूरे ट्रांसमिशन में डेटा की सुरक्षा।

q: At 20% compound interest, the 2nd-year interest is ₹1,480 more than the 1st-year interest. The amount after 2 years is reinvested for 1 year at 18%. Final amount after 3 years?
Project Cheetah was launched in which year?
explain: 17 सितंबर 2022 को कुनो (MP) में नामीबिया से चीते लाए गए।

q: Which pair is correctly matched with its regional folk dance?
explain: बिहू असम का नृत्य; भांगड़ा पंजाब, लावणी महाराष्ट्र, गरबा गुजरात।

q: Which method is commonly used to secure a smartphone against unauthorized access?
explain: स्क्रीन लॉक (PIN/पासवर्ड/बायोमेट्रिक) अनधिकृत पहुँच रोकता है।

q: In Windows, what is a common file extension for a text document?
explain: .txt — टेक्स्ट फ़ाइल।

q: Neither the committee nor the members expressed ___ dissatisfaction overtly, although several concerns were later documented.
explain: Neither…nor में क्रिया/सर्वनाम निकट वाले (members, बहुवचन) से — their।

q: Select the triad that follows the same pattern: BG - EJ - HM, PU - SX - VA
explain: हर पद में दोनों अक्षर +3; पद के भीतर अंतर +5 (B→G)। MR-PU-SX में यही पैटर्न।

q: Which post-Mauryan dynasty of western India and the Deccan had royal women retaining their father's gotra after marriage?
explain: सातवाहन राजाओं के नाम मातृ-गोत्र से (जैसे गौतमीपुत्र) — रानियाँ पिता का गोत्र रखती थीं।

q: Choose the correct indirect statement: The scientist said, "These results do not support our earlier theory."
options: The scientist told that these results had not supported their earlier theory.
The scientist said that these results were not supporting their theory.
The scientist said that these results do not support our earlier theory.
The scientist said that those results did not support their earlier theory.
explain: these→those, do not support→did not support, our→their।

q: As per the Ministry of Coal quarterly booklet (Q1 2025-26), which state was the largest coal producer in FY 2024?
explain: आधिकारिक कुंजी: ओडिशा सबसे बड़ा कोयला उत्पादक।

q: Identify the error: By the time the guests arrived, / she had finish / preparing the dinner / yesterday evening.
options: By the time the guests arrived
explain: Past perfect में V3 — 'had finished'।

q: The black soil of the Deccan plateau, ideal for cotton, is locally known as ______.
explain: काली मिट्टी को 'रेगुर' कहते हैं।

q: What kind of software acts as an intermediary between hardware and user applications?
explain: सिस्टम सॉफ्टवेयर (जैसे OS) हार्डवेयर और एप्लिकेशन के बीच सेतु।

q: By the 1890s, which three leaders criticized the moderates' 'politics of prayers and petitions' and emphasized self-reliance and mass mobilization?
options: Bipin Chandra Pal, Bal Gangadhar Tilak and Lala Lajpat Rai
Surendranath Banerjee, Anandmohan Bose and Romesh Chandra Dutt
Dadabhai Naoroji, G.K. Gokhale and Pherozeshah Mehta
Mahatma Gandhi, Nehru and Sardar Patel
explain: लाल-बाल-पाल — उग्रवादी नेता, स्वराज व जन-आंदोलन के समर्थक।

q: Identify the segment with a grammatical error: They reached the site / after the river / has overflowed during / the previous night.
explain: पहले हुई भूतकाल की क्रिया — 'had overflowed' होना चाहिए।

q: Which Mughal courtier founded the autonomous principality of Hyderabad and the Asaf Jahi dynasty (1724)?
explain: निज़ाम-उल-मुल्क आसफ़ जाह प्रथम ने 1724 में हैदराबाद राज्य स्थापित किया।

q: What does the idiom "Jump on the bandwagon" mean?
options: To join others in doing something popular
To travel quickly to a new place
explain: लोकप्रिय चीज़ में दूसरों के साथ शामिल हो जाना।

q: Best way to change the width of multiple adjacent columns simultaneously in MS Excel?
options: Select the columns and use the Format menu
explain: कॉलम चुनकर Format → Column Width से सभी की चौड़ाई एक साथ।

q: In which district is the Mohiuddinpur Sugar Mill of UP State Sugar Corporation located?
explain: मोहिउद्दीनपुर चीनी मिल मेरठ ज़िले में।

q: SYNONYM of 'reluctant': He was reluctant to accept the new proposal.
explain: Reluctant = unwilling (अनिच्छुक)।

q: Real-time text-based communication between two or more users on the Internet is commonly done using ______.
explain: इंस्टेंट मैसेजिंग — संदेश तुरंत दोनों स्क्रीन पर।

q: Under Article 246 and the Seventh Schedule, which list includes education, forests, marriage and adoption, on which both Parliament and States can legislate?
explain: समवर्ती सूची — शिक्षा, वन, विवाह, दत्तक ग्रहण आदि।

q: What is the primary advantage of using LAN in an organization?
options: It provides virus protection for all devices
It acts as a data backup tool
It enables resource sharing among connected devices
explain: LAN से प्रिंटर, फ़ाइल आदि संसाधन साझा होते हैं।

q: Select the active voice: The homework will be completed by the students.
options: The students are completing the homework.
The students have completed the homework.
The students will complete the homework.
explain: will be + V3 का active — will + V1।

q: Which MS PowerPoint feature previews how a new template will affect your slides before applying it?
explain: Live Preview — क्लिक से पहले ही बदलाव दिखता है।

q: 'रात्रि' का पर्यायवाची शब्द है:
explain: क्षणदा = रात; व्याल = साँप, राजीव = कमल, वाम = बायाँ।

q: Awareness about cleanliness is ______ positive change is visible.
explain: Adverb of place — Everywhere।

q: Which keyboard shortcut in MS PowerPoint starts the presentation from the beginning?
explain: F5 — शुरू से स्लाइड शो; Shift+F5 — वर्तमान स्लाइड से।

q: Which approach reflects the political methods of the moderate INC leaders (1885–1905)?
options: Submission of petitions and resolutions demanding constitutional reforms
explain: नरमपंथी — प्रार्थना, याचिका, प्रस्ताव (संवैधानिक तरीके)।

q: She wants to become ___ engineer who designs innovative solutions.
explain: engineer स्वर ध्वनि से — an।

q: 6 devices at 100% of list price, 10 at 80%, and every additional device at 60%. If the average price is 80% of list price, how many devices in total?
Which strait separates peninsular India from the northernmost part of Sri Lanka?
explain: पाक जलडमरूमध्य भारत (तमिलनाडु) व श्रीलंका (जाफना) के बीच।

q: At the 46th FIDE Chess Olympiad (September 2026), which country won gold in the Women's category?
explain: आधिकारिक कुंजी: महिला वर्ग में स्वर्ण — चीन (ओलंपियाड समरकंद, उज़्बेकिस्तान)।

q: Which component temporarily holds data actively used by the CPU?
explain: RAM अस्थायी (volatile) मेमोरी है।

q: SQO 71, LJH 67, ECA 63, XVT 59, ?
explain: अक्षर −7 (X→Q, V→O, T→M), संख्या −4 → QOM 55।

q: What is the primary function of antivirus software?
explain: मैलवेयर का पता लगाना और हटाना।

q: Exercise Veer Guardian 2026: 1. It is a 14-day India–Japan air exercise at Jodhpur Air Force Station. 2. IAF deployed Su-30 MKI, Rafale and LCA Tejas; JASDF participated with F-2A. Which is correct?
explain: आधिकारिक कुंजी: दोनों कथन सही।

q: Passage: "...Many people get (5)______ to television and consider themselves compensated for the loss of sleep." Fill blank 5.
explain: addicted to — किसी चीज़ की लत लगना।
